looks_for: variables declared in the most-local signature
order: 1) LocalContext[name] (Signature indexer, CaseInsensitiveDictionary on VersionedName); 2) implicit enum member (contains_implicit_enum); 3) implicit FB property __GET<name>/__SET<name>

looks_for: methods/actions/functions declared inside the current (or base) POU
order: DFS over signature chain: FindSubSignatureSet(sig.Name) then BaseExpression (base FB) then InterfaceExpressions (interfaces); reports by name (Operator.Action skipped if IgnoreActions)

looks_for: GVL/global vars of the local application and its parent applications
order: for ctx = LocalContext; ctx != null; ctx = parent: GetSignsForGlobalVar(name) -> for each precompileId: sig=GetSignatureForPrecompileID; if !ATTRIBUTE_QUALIFIED_ONLY then sig[name]

looks_for: global vars published by visible libraries of the local app
order: if none found: GetVisibleLibraries(LocalContext) -> skip GetQualifiedOnly -> GetSignsForGlobalVar -> skip QUALIFIED_ONLY/interfaces for library objects

looks_for: GVL symbols of the Pool context
order: if none found: PoolContext.GetSignsForGlobalVar(name) -> sig[name] (skip QUALIFIED_ONLY)

looks_for: globals from libraries visible to parent applications
order: if none found: GetVisibleLibraries(Pool) -> skip GetQualifiedOnly -> sig[name]

looks_for: super-global signatures (SuperGlobal flag)
order: 1) SuperGlobal context this._3[name] if flag SuperGlobal; 2) Pool[name] if flag SuperGlobal

looks_for: pool symbols (SuperGlobal only via indexer)
order: Pool[name] if SignatureFlag.SuperGlobal

looks_for: any declaration reachable by name (POU/types) with visibility rules
order: iterate GetContexts(): local app + its visible libs, then root app + visible libs, then Pool + visible libs, then SystemContext; for each ctx[name] accept if not QUALIFIED_ONLY (unless local ctx), not SystemNamespaceForced, not Internal when foreign ctx

looks_for: library namespace -> its scope then member
order: GetLibraryContextByNamespace(name[,LocalContext]); if name == LocalContext.Namespace use local; then CheckerScope(ctx)

looks_for: built-in type from an identifier
order: TypeTable.Get(string): ToUpperInvariant, hash-switch over BOOL/BIT/BYTE/WORD/DWORD/LWORD/SINT/INT/DINT/LINT/USINT/UINT/UDINT/ULINT/REAL/LREAL/STRING/WSTRING/TIME/LTIME/DATE/DATEANDTIME/TIMEOFDAY/LDATE/...; fallback ANY/ANYBIT/ANYDATE/ANYINT/ANYNUM/ANYREAL

looks_for: builtin type instance
order: TypeTable.Get(TypeClass) switch (Bool..LTimeOfDay); return builtin singleton

looks_for: builtin type from Operator
order: TypeTable.Get(Operator) switch; GetTypeByOperator(Operator); GetOperatorByType(TypeClass)

looks_for: member of a user-defined type
order: UserdefType.GetSignature(scope)=scope[SignatureId]; components by walking AllVariables + base signature (BaseSignatureId) + interfaces (InterfaceIds) recursively; implicit __MAIN for FB

looks_for: enum constant -> integer value
order: EnumType: signature := scope[SignatureId]; find member by OrgName (case-insensitive), read literal value

looks_for: element type of array access
order: ArrayType.Base / Dimensions; borders are expressions evaluated via scope

looks_for: callable signature matching an argument list
order: 1) if exactly one candidate -> use; 2) if none -> return the base sig; 3) try exact match then 'lazy/implicit-parameter' pass; 4) collect candidates comparing input types; 5) Err_NoMatchingOverload if 0, Err_Ambiguity if >1 (with related positions)

looks_for: whether type A is implicitly convertible/copyable to type B
order: ITypeComparer.IsImplicitConvertable / Imitates / IsImplicitLiteralConvertable; IECType.IsCompatible -> TypeComparerProxy -> VersionedCompilerFactory._TypeComparer

looks_for: name -> symbol with visibility priority layers
order: SymbolTable builds two CaseInsensitiveDictionary layers + property lists; fills in order: local GVL; parent-app GVL; visible libs; pool; parent libs; system context; symbols guarded by QUALIFIED_ONLY / Internal / SystemNamespaceForced

looks_for: variable+signature+scope for an identifier string/expression
order: FindDeclaration(stIdent,..) -> FindDeclaration(IExpression,..): parse access path; if scope-qualified (System/Pool/Namespace/compo) delegate to that scope; else full chain S0..S8
